chat.label: Chat
chat.purpose: Human-led conversation and ordinary Codex work

task.label: Task
task.purpose: Durable Agent-led execution Context with Outcome and stopping contract

notification.label: Notification
notification.purpose: A route back to the exact owning Task, never a work object

livePresence.label: Live
livePresence.purpose: Ephemeral execution presence, never durable Task state

sources.Chats: codex_app_server thread/list searchTerm scoped to the Project folder, merged with the listed tail
sources.Context: vibehub_room durable Context through the canonical Room projection

requirements: Every result shows its object type.
Opening a result preserves its source identity.
Search never converts Chat into Task or Context.

needsYou.dismissal: not dismissible while the canonical Human boundary remains

completion.eligibleWhen: a successful Outcome with closed_at exists
completion.presentation: repository history; unread only when first observed after the running client baseline
completion.dismissal: read state is session-local and never changes the Outcome

deviation.eligibleWhen: a partial, failed, or deviated Outcome exists
deviation.presentation: exception route to the exact Task
deviation.dismissal: cannot hide the canonical REPLAN fact

running.presentation: quiet live affordance outside the notification count

truthBoundaries: Initial bootstrap completion history is never marked unread.
A replayed event, stale runtime observation, reload, or browser cache cannot mint a notification.
Running never generates notification noise by itself.
Color is supplementary to text, icon, group, and exact destination.
